declaration.project: Tengasell — Zimbabwe auction marketplace (Yahoo Auctions functionality, eBay-grade operations)
declaration.businessModel: C2C auctions + buy-now marketplace; revenue = final-value fee (8% capped US$50) + featured listing fees; USD settlement
declaration.owner: Tengasell corporate (Founder/CEO accountable; platform team executes)
declaration.targetProfile: M2 — Operationally Ready, with selected M4 controls elevated by legal obligation (Zimbabwe Cyber & Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] privacy duties, VAT [Chapter 23:12] reporting, Consumer Protection Act [Chapter 14:44], POTRAZ data-controller registration) and by risk (admin MFA, breach workflow, legal holds, records retention)
jurisdictions: Japan (localization market — no entity presence at M2)

flags.cms: Conditional — policy/help content system (not a publishing platform)
flags.payments: Yes — Paynow (ZW) + manual methods (ZIPIT/COD), platform escrow
flags.externalDevelopers: No — Future (internal APIs documented; TrailBase MCP documented)
flags.aiMcpAgents: Conditional — AI assistant (read-only) + TrailBase built-in MCP (deploy-time enablement); agent audit exists
flags.regulatedDomain: Yes — data protection (CDPA), consumer protection, VAT, A2P comms via providers

declaration.environmentAuthority: Sandbox: Next :3000 (gateway :81), TrailBase :3001, trade-engine :3002, GIS :3004, comms :3005, finance :3006, trust :3007, govern :3008
declaration.scoringRule: M2 gate ≥90% weighted + all applicable C3/C4 controls ≥ Evidenced (S60) with runtime proof; critical failures override percentages
